已创建 `.speckit.tasks` 文件。

**超时原因分析：**
1. 内容过多：如果一次性写入大量内容，可能导致超时
2. 文件操作：大文件写入需要更长时间

**解决方案：**
- 创建精简版本：只包含核心任务信息（任务名称、时间估算、文件位置）
- 避免冗余：不重复 `.speckit.plan` 中的详细描述
- 保持简洁：使用 Markdown 列表格式，便于阅读和更新

**文件特点：**
- 包含 5 个阶段的所有任务
- 每个任务标注了时间估算和文件位置
- 使用复选框格式，便于跟踪进度
- 文件大小约 1KB，避免超时

如需更详细的任务信息，可查看 `.speckit.plan` 文件。`.speckit.tasks` 主要用于快速查看任务列表和跟踪进度。

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,328 @@

+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Price line management module for vnpy chart.
+ 
+ This module provides price line functionality for drawing order trading,
+ including price line display, drag interaction, and order management.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ from enum import Enum
+ from typing import Optional
+ 
+ import pyqtgraph as pg  # type: ignore
+ 
+ from vnpy.trader.ui import QtGui, QtCore
+ 
+ from .base import UP_COLOR, DOWN_COLOR, PEN_WIDTH, NORMAL_FONT
+ 
+ 
+ class PriceLineType(Enum):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Price line type enumeration.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+     ENTRY = &quot;entry&quot;           # 入场线（已成交）
+     PENDING = &quot;pending&quot;       # 挂单线（未成交）
+     STOP_LOSS = &quot;stop_loss&quot;   # 止损线
+     TAKE_PROFIT = &quot;take_profit&quot;  # 止盈线
+     PREVIEW = &quot;preview&quot;       # 预览线（临时显示）
+ 
+ 
+ class PriceLineItem(pg.InfiniteLine):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+     Price line item based on pyqtgraph InfiniteLine.
+     
+     Supports horizontal price line display with customizable style.
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+     def __init__(
+         self,
+         price: float,
+         line_type: PriceLineType,
+         direction: str = &quot;long&quot;,
+         movable: bool = False,
+         parent: Optional[pg.GraphicsObject] = None
+     ) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Initialize price line item.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: Price value for the line
+             line_type: Type of price line (ENTRY, PENDING, etc.)
+             direction: Trading direction (&quot;long&quot; or &quot;short&quot;)
+             movable: Whether the line can be dragged
+             parent: Parent graphics object
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         # Create pen based on line type and direction
+         pen = self._create_pen(line_type, direction)
+         
+         # Create label text
+         label = self._create_label(price, line_type)
+         
+         # Initialize InfiniteLine (angle=0 for horizontal line)
+         super().__init__(
+             angle=0,
+             pos=price,
+             pen=pen,
+             movable=movable,
+             label=label,
+             labelOpts={
+                 &quot;position&quot;: 0.95,
+                 &quot;color&quot;: pen.color(),
+                 &quot;font&quot;: NORMAL_FONT
+             }
+         )
+         
+         self._price: float = price
+         self._line_type: PriceLineType = line_type
+         self._direction: str = direction
+         self._original_price: float = price
+ 
+     def _create_pen(
+         self,
+         line_type: PriceLineType,
+         direction: str
+     ) -&gt; QtGui.QPen:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Create pen for price line based on type and direction.
+ 
+         Args:
+             line_type: Type of price line
+             direction: Trading direction
+ 
+         Returns:
+             QPen object with appropriate style
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         # Determine color based on direction (红涨青跌，中国惯例)
+         if direction == &quot;long&quot;:
+             base_color = UP_COLOR  # Red for long
+         else:
+             base_color = DOWN_COLOR  # Cyan for short
+ 
+         # Determine line style based on type
+         if line_type == PriceLineType.ENTRY:
+             # Entry line: solid
+             style = QtCore.Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine
+             width = PEN_WIDTH + 1
+         elif line_type == PriceLineType.PENDING:
+             # Pending order line: dotted
+             style = QtCore.Qt.PenStyle.DotLine
+             width = PEN_WIDTH
+         elif line_type in (PriceLineType.STOP_LOSS, PriceLineType.TAKE_PROFIT):
+             # Stop loss / Take profit: dashed
+             style = QtCore.Qt.PenStyle.DashLine
+             width = PEN_WIDTH
+         elif line_type == PriceLineType.PREVIEW:
+             # Preview line: dotted, semi-transparent
+             style = QtCore.Qt.PenStyle.DotLine
+             width = PEN_WIDTH
+             # Make preview line semi-transparent
+             color = (*base_color[:3], 128)  # Add alpha channel
+             return pg.mkPen(color=color, width=width, style=style)
+         else:
+             style = QtCore.Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine
+             width = PEN_WIDTH
+ 
+         return pg.mkPen(color=base_color, width=width, style=style)
+ 
+     def _create_label(
+         self,
+         price: float,
+         line_type: PriceLineType
+     ) -&gt; str:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Create label text for price line.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: Price value
+             line_type: Type of price line
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Label text string
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         type_names = {
+             PriceLineType.ENTRY: &quot;入场&quot;,
+             PriceLineType.PENDING: &quot;挂单&quot;,
+             PriceLineType.STOP_LOSS: &quot;止损&quot;,
+             PriceLineType.TAKE_PROFIT: &quot;止盈&quot;,
+             PriceLineType.PREVIEW: &quot;预览&quot;
+         }
+         
+         type_name = type_names.get(line_type, &quot;&quot;)
+         return f&quot;{type_name} {price:.2f}&quot;
+ 
+     def get_price(self) -&gt; float:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Get current price of the line.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._price
+ 
+     def set_price(self, price: float) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Update price of the line.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: New price value
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self._price = price
+         self.setPos(price)
+         # Update label
+         label = self._create_label(price, self._line_type)
+         self.setLabel(label)
+ 
+     def get_line_type(self) -&gt; PriceLineType:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Get line type.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._line_type
+ 
+     def get_direction(self) -&gt; str:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Get trading direction.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._direction
+ 
+     def get_original_price(self) -&gt; float:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Get original price (before drag).&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._original_price
+ 
+     def set_original_price(self, price: float) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Set original price (for drag cancel).&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self._original_price = price
+ 
+ 
+ class PriceLineManager:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+     Manager for all price lines in the chart.
+     
+     Handles creation, update, and deletion of price lines.
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+     def __init__(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Initialize price line manager.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         # Map: line_id -&gt; PriceLineItem
+         self._lines: dict[str, PriceLineItem] = {}
+         
+         # Counter for generating unique line IDs
+         self._line_id_counter: int = 0
+ 
+     def create_line(
+         self,
+         price: float,
+         line_type: PriceLineType,
+         direction: str = &quot;long&quot;,
+         movable: bool = False,
+         line_id: Optional[str] = None
+     ) -&gt; str:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Create a new price line.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: Price value
+             line_type: Type of price line
+             direction: Trading direction (&quot;long&quot; or &quot;short&quot;)
+             movable: Whether the line can be dragged
+             line_id: Optional custom line ID. If None, auto-generate.
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Line ID string
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if line_id is None:
+             line_id = f&quot;line_{self._line_id_counter}&quot;
+             self._line_id_counter += 1
+ 
+         if line_id in self._lines:
+             raise ValueError(f&quot;Line ID {line_id} already exists&quot;)
+ 
+         line = PriceLineItem(
+             price=price,
+             line_type=line_type,
+             direction=direction,
+             movable=movable
+         )
+ 
+         self._lines[line_id] = line
+         return line_id
+ 
+     def get_line(self, line_id: str) -&gt; Optional[PriceLineItem]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Get price line by ID.
+ 
+         Args:
+             line_id: Line ID
+ 
+         Returns:
+             PriceLineItem or None if not found
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._lines.get(line_id)
+ 
+     def update_line_price(self, line_id: str, price: float) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Update price of a line.
+ 
+         Args:
+             line_id: Line ID
+             price: New price value
+ 
+         Returns:
+             True if successful, False if line not found
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         line = self._lines.get(line_id)
+         if line is None:
+             return False
+ 
+         line.set_price(price)
+         return True
+ 
+     def delete_line(self, line_id: str) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Delete a price line.
+ 
+         Args:
+             line_id: Line ID
+ 
+         Returns:
+             True if successful, False if line not found
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         line = self._lines.pop(line_id, None)
+         if line is None:
+             return False
+ 
+         # Remove from plot if it has a parent
+         if line.scene() is not None:
+             plot = line.getViewBox()
+             if plot is not None:
+                 plot.removeItem(line)
+ 
+         return True
+ 
+     def get_all_lines(self) -&gt; dict[str, PriceLineItem]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Get all price lines.
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Dictionary mapping line_id to PriceLineItem
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._lines.copy()
+ 
+     def get_lines_by_type(self, line_type: PriceLineType) -&gt; list[PriceLineItem]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Get all lines of a specific type.
+ 
+         Args:
+             line_type: Type of price line
+ 
+         Returns:
+             List of PriceLineItem objects
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return [
+             line for line in self._lines.values()
+             if line.get_line_type() == line_type
+         ]
+ 
+     def clear_all(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Clear all price lines.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         # Remove all lines from their plots
+         for line in list(self._lines.values()):
+             if line.scene() is not None:
+                 plot = line.getViewBox()
+                 if plot is not None:
+                     plot.removeItem(line)
+ 
+         self._lines.clear()
+ 
+     def get_count(self) -&gt; int:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Get total number of price lines.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return len(self._lines)
+ 
```

已完成 Phase 1 的前 4 个任务。总结如下：

## Phase 1 进度总结

### 已完成的任务

1. **创建 PriceLineItem 类** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - 基于 `pg.InfiniteLine` 封装
   - 支持水平价格线显示
   - 实现样式配置（颜色、线宽、线型）
   - 支持 5 种价格线类型：ENTRY, PENDING, STOP_LOSS, TAKE_PROFIT, PREVIEW
   - 支持方向（long/short）和颜色方案（红涨青跌）

2. **实现 PriceLineManager 类** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - 管理所有价格线的生命周期
   - 实现创建、更新、删除功能
   - 使用字典存储，支持按类型查询
   - 支持唯一 ID 管理

3. **集成到 ChartWidget** (`vnpy/chart/widget.py`)
   - 在 ChartWidget 中添加 PriceLineManager 实例
   - 添加 `add_price_line()` 方法
   - 添加 `remove_price_line()` 方法
   - 添加 `get_price_line_manager()` 方法
   - 在 `clear_all()` 中清理价格线

4. **实现价格线样式配置** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - 颜色方案：红涨青跌（中国惯例）
   - 线型映射：实线（ENTRY）、虚线（止损/止盈）、点线（挂单/预览）
   - 标签显示：价格和类型标识
   - 预览线支持半透明显示

### 代码质量

- 无 linter 错误
- 符合 vnpy 代码规范
- 包含类型提示和文档字符串
- 已更新 `__init__.py` 导出新类

## Phase 1 完成总结

### 已完成的任务

1. **创建 PriceLineItem 类** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - 基于 `pg.InfiniteLine` 封装
   - 支持水平价格线显示
   - 实现样式配置（颜色、线宽、线型）
   - 支持 5 种价格线类型和方向

2. **实现 PriceLineManager 类** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - 管理所有价格线的生命周期
   - 实现创建、更新、删除功能
   - 支持按类型查询

3. **集成到 ChartWidget** (`vnpy/chart/widget.py`)
   - 添加 PriceLineManager 实例
   - 添加 `add_price_line()` 和 `remove_price_line()` 方法
   - 在 `clear_all()` 中清理价格线

4. **实现价格线样式配置** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - 颜色方案：红涨青跌
   - 线型映射：实线、虚线、点线
   - 标签显示：价格和类型标识

5. **单元测试** (`tests/test_chart_price_line.py`)
   - 25 个测试用例
   - 覆盖价格线创建和删除
   - 覆盖价格线样式配置
   - 覆盖价格线管理器状态

### 代码质量

- 无 linter 错误
- 符合 vnpy 代码规范
- 包含类型提示和文档字符串
- 已更新 `__init__.py` 导出新类
- 已修复 pyqtgraph labelOpts 的 font 参数问题

- `vnpy/chart/__init__.py` - 修改（导出新类）

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,223 @@
- 
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Price line drag interaction module.
+ 
+ Handles mouse hover detection, drag state management, and ESC cancel mechanism
+ for draggable price lines.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ from typing import Optional
+ 
+ import pyqtgraph as pg  # type: ignore
+ 
+ from vnpy.trader.ui import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets
+ 
+ from .price_line import PriceLineItem, PriceLineType
+ 
+ 
+ # Default hover detection threshold (pixels)
+ DEFAULT_HOVER_THRESHOLD = 10
+ 
+ 
+ class PriceLineDragHandler:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+     Handler for price line drag interactions.
+     
+     Manages hover detection, drag state, and coordinate conversion.
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+     def __init__(self, plot: pg.PlotItem) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Initialize drag handler.
+ 
+         Args:
+             plot: PlotItem where price lines are displayed
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self._plot: pg.PlotItem = plot
+         self._hover_threshold: float = DEFAULT_HOVER_THRESHOLD
+         
+         # Drag state
+         self._is_dragging: bool = False
+         self._dragging_line: Optional[PriceLineItem] = None
+         self._drag_start_price: float = 0.0
+ 
+     def set_hover_threshold(self, threshold: float) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Set hover detection threshold in pixels.
+ 
+         Args:
+             threshold: Distance in pixels to detect hover
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self._hover_threshold = threshold
+ 
+     def find_line_near_point(
+         self,
+         pos: QtCore.QPointF,
+         lines: list[PriceLineItem]
+     ) -&gt; Optional[PriceLineItem]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Find price line near the given point.
+ 
+         Args:
+             pos: Mouse position in scene coordinates
+             lines: List of price lines to check
+ 
+         Returns:
+             PriceLineItem if found, None otherwise
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         view_box = self._plot.getViewBox()
+         if view_box is None:
+             return None
+ 
+         # Convert scene position to view coordinates
+         view_pos = view_box.mapSceneToView(pos)
+         
+         # Get Y coordinate (price)
+         mouse_price = view_pos.y()
+ 
+         # Find the closest line
+         closest_line: Optional[PriceLineItem] = None
+         min_distance = float(&#39;inf&#39;)
+ 
+         for line in lines:
+             if not line.movable:
+                 continue
+ 
+             line_price = line.get_price()
+             distance = abs(mouse_price - line_price)
+ 
+             # Convert price distance to pixels
+             # Get view range to calculate pixel-to-price ratio
+             view_range = view_box.viewRange()
+             if view_range:
+                 y_range = view_range[1]  # (y_min, y_max)
+                 y_height = y_range[1] - y_range[0]
+                 
+                 # Get plot height in pixels
+                 plot_height = view_box.height()
+                 if plot_height &gt; 0:
+                     price_per_pixel = y_height / plot_height
+                     distance_pixels = distance / price_per_pixel
+ 
+                     if distance_pixels &lt; self._hover_threshold and distance_pixels &lt; min_distance:
+                         min_distance = distance_pixels
+                         closest_line = line
+ 
+         return closest_line
+ 
+     def start_drag(self, line: PriceLineItem) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Start dragging a price line.
+ 
+         Args:
+             line: Price line to drag
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not line.movable:
+             return
+ 
+         self._is_dragging = True
+         self._dragging_line = line
+         self._drag_start_price = line.get_price()
+         line.set_original_price(self._drag_start_price)
+ 
+     def update_drag(self, new_price: float) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Update drag position.
+ 
+         Args:
+             new_price: New price value
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._is_dragging or self._dragging_line is None:
+             return
+ 
+         self._dragging_line.set_price(new_price)
+ 
+     def end_drag(self) -&gt; Optional[float]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         End dragging and return final price.
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Final price if drag was active, None otherwise
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._is_dragging or self._dragging_line is None:
+             return None
+ 
+         final_price = self._dragging_line.get_price()
+         self._is_dragging = False
+         self._dragging_line = None
+         self._drag_start_price = 0.0
+ 
+         return final_price
+ 
+     def cancel_drag(self) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Cancel drag and restore original price.
+ 
+         Returns:
+             True if drag was cancelled, False if no drag was active
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._is_dragging or self._dragging_line is None:
+             return False
+ 
+         # Restore original price
+         original_price = self._dragging_line.get_original_price()
+         self._dragging_line.set_price(original_price)
+ 
+         # Clear drag state
+         self._is_dragging = False
+         self._dragging_line = None
+         self._drag_start_price = 0.0
+ 
+         return True
+ 
+     def is_dragging(self) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Check if currently dragging.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._is_dragging
+ 
+     def get_dragging_line(self) -&gt; Optional[PriceLineItem]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Get currently dragging line.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._dragging_line
+ 
+     def convert_scene_to_price(self, scene_pos: QtCore.QPointF) -&gt; Optional[float]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Convert scene coordinates to price value.
+ 
+         Args:
+             scene_pos: Position in scene coordinates
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Price value or None if conversion fails
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         view_box = self._plot.getViewBox()
+         if view_box is None:
+             return None
+ 
+         view_pos = view_box.mapSceneToView(scene_pos)
+         return view_pos.y()
+ 
+     def convert_price_to_scene(self, price: float) -&gt; Optional[QtCore.QPointF]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Convert price value to scene coordinates.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: Price value
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Scene position or None if conversion fails
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         view_box = self._plot.getViewBox()
+         if view_box is None:
+             return None
+ 
+         # Use current x position (middle of view)
+         view_range = view_box.viewRange()
+         if not view_range:
+             return None
+ 
+         x_range = view_range[0]
+         x_center = (x_range[0] + x_range[1]) / 2
+ 
+         view_pos = QtCore.QPointF(x_center, price)
+         scene_pos = view_box.mapViewToScene(view_pos)
+ 
+         return scene_pos
+ 
```

```diff
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Handle mouse move event for price line hover detection and dragging.
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._price_line_drag_handler or not self._first_plot:
+             super().mouseMoveEvent(event)
+             return
+ 
+         # Get scene position
+         scene_pos = self.mapToScene(event.pos())
+         
+         # Get all price lines
+         all_lines = list(self._price_line_manager.get_all_lines().values())
+         
+         # If dragging, update drag position
+         if self._price_line_drag_handler.is_dragging():
+             new_price = self._price_line_drag_handler.convert_scene_to_price(scene_pos)
+             if new_price is not None:
+                 self._price_line_drag_handler.update_drag(new_price)
+         else:
+             # Check for hover
+             hovered_line = self._price_line_drag_handler.find_line_near_point(
+                 scene_pos, all_lines
+             )
+             
+             # Change cursor style
+             if hovered_line:
+                 self.setCursor(QtCore.Qt.CursorShape.SizeVerCursor)
+             else:
+                 self.setCursor(QtCore.Qt.CursorShape.ArrowCursor)
+

+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._price_line_drag_handler or not self._first_plot:
+             super().mousePressEvent(event)
+             return
+ 
+         # Only handle left button
+         if event.button() != QtCore.Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
+             super().mousePressEvent(event)
+             return
+ 
+         # Get scene position
+         scene_pos = self.mapToScene(event.pos())
+         
+         # Get all price lines
+         all_lines = list(self._price_line_manager.get_all_lines().values())
+         
+         # Find line near click position
+         clicked_line = self._price_line_drag_handler.find_line_near_point(
+             scene_pos, all_lines
+         )
+         
+         if clicked_line and clicked_line.movable:
+             self._price_line_drag_handler.start_drag(clicked_line)
+             event.accept()
+             return
+ 
+         super().mousePressEvent(event)
+

+         &quot;&quot;&quot;

+         - Double click pending line: Delete entire pending order
+         - Double click entry line: Close position
+         - Double click stop loss/take profit line: Delete the line
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._price_line_drag_handler or not self._first_plot:
```

## Phase 2 完成总结

### 已完成的任务

1. **实现 DraggablePriceLine 类** (`vnpy/chart/price_line.py`)
   - `PriceLineItem` 已支持 `movable` 参数
   - 基于 `pg.InfiniteLine`，支持拖拽
   - 实现坐标转换（价格 ↔ 像素）

2. **鼠标悬停检测** (`vnpy/chart/price_line_drag.py`)
   - 实现 `PriceLineDragHandler.find_line_near_point()` 方法
   - 检测阈值：默认 10 像素（可配置）
   - 在 `mouseMoveEvent` 中改变光标样式（SizeVerCursor）

3. **拖拽状态管理** (`vnpy/chart/price_line_drag.py`)
   - 实现拖拽状态跟踪（`isDragging`, `draggingLine`）
   - 保存原始价格用于取消恢复
   - 实时更新价格线位置和标签
   - 实现 `start_drag()`, `update_drag()`, `end_drag()` 方法

4. **ESC 取消/恢复机制** (`vnpy/chart/widget.py`)
   - 在 `keyPressEvent` 中监听 ESC 键
   - 取消拖拽时恢复原始价格
   - 清理拖拽状态

5. **双击事件处理** (`vnpy/chart/widget.py`)
   - 重写 `mouseDoubleClickEvent`
   - 双击挂单线 → 删除该线（Phase 3 将扩展为删除整个挂单）
   - 双击入场线 → 预留接口（Phase 3 将实现平仓）
   - 双击止损/止盈线 → 删除该线

### 新增文件

- `vnpy/chart/price_line_drag.py` - 拖拽交互处理模块（224 行）

### 修改文件

- `vnpy/chart/widget.py` - 添加鼠标事件处理和双击事件处理
- `vnpy/chart/__init__.py` - 导出 `PriceLineDragHandler`

### 核心功能实现

1. **坐标转换**
   - `convert_scene_to_price()` - 场景坐标转价格
   - `convert_price_to_scene()` - 价格转场景坐标
   - 使用 `mapSceneToView()` 和 `mapViewToScene()`

2. **鼠标事件处理**
   - `mouseMoveEvent` - 悬停检测和拖拽更新
   - `mousePressEvent` - 开始拖拽
   - `mouseReleaseEvent` - 结束拖拽
   - `mouseDoubleClickEvent` - 双击操作

3. **键盘事件处理**
   - `keyPressEvent` - ESC 键取消拖拽

### 代码质量

- 无 linter 错误
- 符合 vnpy 代码规范
- 包含类型提示和文档字符串
- 已更新 `__init__.py` 导出新类

### 技术要点

- 使用 pyqtgraph 的坐标转换 API
- 实现像素到价格的精确转换
- 支持可配置的悬停检测阈值
- 完整的拖拽状态管理

Phase 2 已完成。所有拖拽交互功能已实现并集成到 ChartWidget 中。

可以继续 Phase 3：画线下单功能，或先测试当前实现。

```diff
+         assert original_price == 100.0
+ 
+         # Update price

+         assert line.get_price() == 105.0
+         assert line.get_original_price() == 100.0  # Original unchanged

+     def test_drag_state_transitions(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Test drag state transitions.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         from vnpy.chart.price_line_drag import PriceLineDragHandler
+         import pyqtgraph as pg
+ 
+         plot = pg.PlotItem()
+         handler = PriceLineDragHandler(plot)
+ 
+         line = PriceLineItem(
+             price=100.0,
+             line_type=PriceLineType.PENDING,
+             direction=&quot;long&quot;,
+             movable=True
+         )
+ 
+         # Initial state
+         assert not handler.is_dragging()
+         assert handler.get_dragging_line() is None
+ 
+         # Start drag
+         handler.start_drag(line)
+         assert handler.is_dragging()
+         assert handler.get_dragging_line() == line
+ 
+         # Update drag
+         handler.update_drag(105.0)
+         assert handler.is_dragging()
+         assert line.get_price() == 105.0
+ 
+         # End drag
+         handler.end_drag()
+         assert not handler.is_dragging()
+         assert handler.get_dragging_line() is None
+
```

```diff
+         assert short_line.get_direction() == &quot;short&quot;
```

```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Drawing order mode controller.
+ 
+ Manages drawing order mode state, preview line display, and order creation.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ from typing import Optional
+ 
+ import pyqtgraph as pg  # type: ignore
+ 
+ from vnpy.trader.ui import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets
+ 
+ from .price_line import PriceLineItem, PriceLineManager, PriceLineType
+ from .price_line_drag import PriceLineDragHandler
+ 
+ 
+ class DrawingOrderController:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+     Controller for drawing order mode.
+     
+     Manages drawing mode state, preview line, and order creation workflow.
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+     def __init__(
+         self,
+         widget: &quot;ChartWidget&quot;,
+         price_line_manager: PriceLineManager,
+         drag_handler: PriceLineDragHandler
+     ) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Initialize drawing order controller.
+ 
+         Args:
+             widget: ChartWidget instance
+             price_line_manager: PriceLineManager instance
+             drag_handler: PriceLineDragHandler instance
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self._widget = widget
+         self._price_line_manager = price_line_manager
+         self._drag_handler = drag_handler
+ 
+         # Drawing mode state
+         self._drawing_mode_enabled: bool = False
+         
+         # Preview line
+         self._preview_line: Optional[PriceLineItem] = None
+         self._preview_line_id: Optional[str] = None
+ 
+     def is_enabled(self) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Check if drawing mode is enabled.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return self._drawing_mode_enabled
+ 
+     def enable(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Enable drawing order mode.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if self._drawing_mode_enabled:
+             return
+ 
+         self._drawing_mode_enabled = True
+         # Change cursor to indicate drawing mode
+         if self._widget:
+             self._widget.setCursor(QtCore.Qt.CursorShape.CrossCursor)
+ 
+     def disable(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Disable drawing order mode.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not self._drawing_mode_enabled:
+             return
+ 
+         self._drawing_mode_enabled = False
+         
+         # Remove preview line
+         self._hide_preview_line()
+         
+         # Restore cursor
+         if self._widget:
+             self._widget.setCursor(QtCore.Qt.CursorShape.ArrowCursor)
+ 
+     def toggle(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Toggle drawing mode on/off.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if self._drawing_mode_enabled:
+             self.disable()
+         else:
+             self.enable()
+ 
+     def show_preview_line(self, price: float, direction: str = &quot;long&quot;) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Show preview line at given price.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: Price value for preview line
+             direction: Trading direction (&quot;long&quot; or &quot;short&quot;)
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         # Remove existing preview line
+         self._hide_preview_line()
+ 
+         # Create new preview line
+         self._preview_line_id = self._price_line_manager.create_line(
+             price=price,
+             line_type=PriceLineType.PREVIEW,
+             direction=direction,
+             movable=False
+         )
+ 
+         self._preview_line = self._price_line_manager.get_line(self._preview_line_id)
+ 
+         # Add to plot
+         if self._preview_line and self._widget._first_plot:
+             self._widget._first_plot.addItem(self._preview_line)
+ 
+     def update_preview_line(self, price: float) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Update preview line position.
+ 
+         Args:
+             price: New price value
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if self._preview_line:
+             self._preview_line.set_price(price)
+ 
+     def _hide_preview_line(self) -&gt; None:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Hide and remove preview line.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if self._preview_line_id:
+             self._price_line_manager.delete_line(self._preview_line_id)
+             self._preview_line_id = None
+             self._preview_line = None
+ 
+     def get_preview_price(self) -&gt; Optional[float]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Get current preview line price.
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Price value or None if no preview line
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if self._preview_line:
+             return self._preview_line.get_price()
+         return None
+ 
+     def confirm_preview_price(self) -&gt; Optional[float]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Confirm preview price and return it.
+ 
+         Returns:
+             Confirmed price or None if no preview line
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         price = self.get_preview_price()
+         if price is not None:
+             # Remove preview line
+             self._hide_preview_line()
+         return price
+
```
